summary:
ORBITE 3 is an immersive educational 3D game designed to help young people and aspiring astronauts learn about space exploration through interactive experiences. Instead of relying on lengthy theoretical materials, players embark on a mission from Earth to Mars, where they must adapt to the Martian environment, explore their surroundings, experiment, build useful systems, and develop the skills needed to survive.

Through six progressive levels, players discover essential aspects of space exploration, including life-support systems, energy production, radiation protection, agriculture, and resource management. Each decision has consequences, encouraging critical thinking, problem-solving, and practical learning.

By transforming complex scientific concepts into an engaging game, ORBITE 3 makes space education more accessible, enjoyable, and meaningful. Its ultimate goal is to inspire the next generation of space explorers and prepare them to understand the challenges of living beyond Earth.
details:
What Does ORBITE 3 Do?

ORBITE 3 is an educational 3D space exploration game that places players in the role of an astronaut on a mission to Mars. The experience begins on Earth, where players prepare for departure and board a spacecraft. After completing their journey, they land on Mars and begin adapting to their new environment.

The game is structured around six progressive levels:

  1. Leaving Earth: Preparing for the space mission and discovering the spacecraft.
  2. Landing on Mars: Completing the journey and landing safely on the Red Planet.
  3. Adapting to Life: Discovering the Martian habitat, resources, and survival conditions.
  4. Discovering and Creating: Exploring the environment, experimenting, and developing new knowledge.
  5. Building Products: Using available resources and acquired skills to manufacture useful products.
  6. Mastering Mars: Applying acquired knowledge to manage resources and develop a sustainable Martian environment.

How Does It Work?

Players learn through exploration, interaction, experimentation, and decision-making. Throughout their journey, they interact with different environments, equipment, and resources while completing activities and challenges.

The game focuses on four essential systems:

  • Life Support: Maintaining breathable air and water through recycling systems.
  • Energy Production: Generating enough energy to power the Martian base.
  • Agriculture: Growing food while managing water, energy, and available space.
  • Radiation Protection: Protecting astronauts from the dangerous radiation present on Mars.

These systems are interconnected. Every installation requires resources, and every decision creates consequences. For example, investing too heavily in energy production may reduce the space available for agriculture. Players must therefore find a balance between competing priorities to maintain a sustainable environment.

Benefits and Intended Impact

ORBITE 3 transforms scientific and technical knowledge into practical learning experiences. Rather than simply reading about space exploration, players discover how scientific concepts work by applying them in simulated situations.

The project aims to:

  • Make space science more accessible to students and beginners.
  • Develop problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Introduce players to the challenges of living and working on Mars.
  • Encourage interest in STEM education, science, technology, and space exploration.
  • Demonstrate the importance of resource management and sustainable living in extraterrestrial environments.

Our long-term vision is to make ORBITE 3 an educational platform that can also support teachers, schools, and STEM communities.

Technologies and Tools

The project is being developed using modern web and 3D technologies:

  • Next.js: Main web application framework.
  • React 19: Building interactive user interfaces.
  • Three.js: Creating and rendering the 3D environment.
  • React Three Fiber: Integrating Three.js into the React ecosystem.
  • @react-three/drei: Simplifying 3D scene development and interactions.
  • TypeScript: Improving code reliability and maintainability.
  • Tailwind CSS: Styling and designing the interface.
  • GSAP: Creating animations and smooth transitions.
  • GitHub: Source code management and version control.
  • Cursor and Claude: AI-assisted development, coding support, and problem-solving.
  • GitHub Copilot: AI-assisted code completion and development productivity.

Creativity and Innovation

The creative aspect of ORBITE 3 lies in combining 3D exploration, educational gaming, and simulated astronaut training into a single experience.

Inspired by immersive virtual worlds and interactive adventure games, the project moves beyond traditional educational platforms. Players are not passive learners; they become active participants in a space mission.

The six-level progression gradually introduces new challenges while retaining previously acquired knowledge. This creates an interconnected learning experience in which players understand that survival on Mars depends on several systems working together.

Factors Considered During Development

Our team considered scientific relevance, educational accessibility, gameplay progression, resource constraints, and the technical feasibility of creating an interactive 3D environment.

We also considered the importance of making the experience engaging for beginners without losing the complexity of real space exploration challenges.

NASA scientific resources, including radiation measurements collected by the Curiosity rover, are intended to support more realistic simulations as the project evolves.

Ultimately, ORBITE 3 aims to turn curiosity about space into knowledge, practical skills, and a deeper understanding of humanity's challenges in exploring and inhabiting other planets.
